newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 614 MW Homer City coal unit back after repairs.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 614 MW Homer City coal unit back after repairs.

text.p: A 614 megawatt (MW) unit at the Homer City, Pa., coal-fired generating station reconnected to the grid Thursday after its was shut Wednesday to repair a precipitator, the operator said.
"It came back on line this morning," said a spokesman for GPU Generation Inc, referring to Homer City's unit 2.
The adjacent 620 MW unit 1 and 650 MW unit 3 were operating at full production, the GPU spokesman said.
Pennsylvania Electric Co (Penelec) and New York State Electric & Gas Co each have a 50 percent stake in the Homer City units.
Both Penelec and GPU Generation are subsidiaries of GPU Inc of Parsippany, N.J.
The three Homer City units represent 11 percent of GPU Inc's total generating capacity.
